query:
WITH removed AS (
            DELETE FROM delphi_tech_review_queue
            WHERE project_id = ANY($1::bigint[])
            RETURNING project_id
        )
        SELECT
            removed.project_id AS "project_id!: DBProjectId",
            (
                SELECT thread.id
                FROM threads thread
                WHERE thread.mod_id = removed.project_id
                ORDER BY thread.id
                LIMIT 1
            ) AS "thread_id!: DBThreadId"
        FROM removed
